title: MAN Lion's City G CNG (A23 facelift) - exterior spec for the three.js bus model
bus: MAN Lion's City G CNG, 18 m articulated, 3 axles, 4 double doors on the right side; Sofia, Stolichen Avtotransport; photos: fleet 3145 (CB 5696 HM), 3153 (CB 5713 HM), 2319 (CB 5720 HM)

how_to_read.confidence: high = two independent sources or directly measured and cross-checked; medium = one source or one photo measurement (+/-0.1 m); low = inferred (typology / proportions) or +/-0.3 m

basis_tags.P3cam: metric back-projection with a pinhole camera fitted to photo 3 (registration plate + 3 wheel ground points; residual 2-3 px; plate frame assumed 0.54 x 0.15 m with its bottom edge 0.33 m above ground). Heights/lateral positions +/-0.05..0.1 m near the front, +/-0.3 m along the far end of the bus
basis_tags.P2rect / P1rect: photo 2 / photo 1 perspective-rectified onto the plane of the registration plate (valid for the flat centre of the lower front only; crops/rect_p2_lower.png, crops/rect_p1_lower.png)

frames.bus_xyz: x = +right (kerb / door side), y = up from the ground, z = backwards. +x is the image-LEFT side in a front view.
frames.S: distance in metres BEHIND the front face plane, measured along the FRONT section. BusSpec front frame: z = -7.805 + S (FRONT_Z = -(2.7+5.105)). Axle 1 at S=2.70, axle 2 at S=7.805 (z=0)
frames.rear_frame: BusSpec rear frame: origin = axle 3 centre on the ground, z backwards (+). Rear face at z=+3.405.
frames.front_elevation: lists named (x, Y) are in the bus frame: x>0 = bus right = image-left when looking at the bus from the front

which_side_is_which.photo_1: shows the bus RIGHT (kerb, door) side. Door 1 is open at image-left of the windscreen. (The brief labels it 'front-left'; it is the right side.)
which_side_is_which.photo_3: shows the bus RIGHT (kerb, door) side, front section and rear section behind the bellows
which_side_is_which.photo_2: shows the bus LEFT (driver) side: no doors on this side, big uninterrupted window band, flap panel ahead of the front wheel; the compact tall black mirror box at image-right is the LEFT mirror; the ram's horn at image-left is the RIGHT mirror
which_side_is_which.conclusion: The curved 'ram's horn' arm mirror is ONLY on the RIGHT (kerb) side. The LEFT (driver) mirror is a compact two-segment rectangular box bolted straight to the A-pillar corner. The game model currently puts identical ram's-horn arms on both sides - wrong.

lower_front_colours.white_zones: everything below Y 1.0 except the grille, the plate and the lamp lenses (about 75 % of the lower front is WHITE)
lower_front_colours.black_zones: grille trapezoid, windscreen base band (Y 1.0-1.22), the LED header (Y 2.30-2.86), the mirror housings, the door/A-pillar frames

face_profile.centre_panel: flat, vertical, |x| <= 0.78, from bumper bottom Y 0.31 to the chrome strip Y 1.00; carries grille, MAN letters, plate, fleet number, lion emblem
face_profile.corner_modules: outside |x| = 0.78 the face wraps back in a radius of about 0.5 m; a vertical seam (visible as a curved line, P2rect u = +/-780 mm) separates the centre bumper from the corner modules; the corner modules carry the headlamp + indicator/fog units and (right side only) the three blue pictograms
face_profile.bumper_lower_edge: Y 0.31 centre, rising to about 0.40 at the corners; the lower valance is a separate white moulding below the grille with a straight seam at Y about 0.50 (grille bottom)

grille_black_polygon.description: gloss-black trapezoid, side edges slant inwards by about 0.14 m over 0.26 m, lower corners chamfered; very fine horizontal texture; a thin vertical chrome/grey bar is visible at both lower-outer edges. Plane about 0.01-0.02 m behind the white face (recessed).

man_letters.style: 3D satin-chrome extended bold sans 'MAN' (A without crossbar-style, MAN corporate type), raised 0.01 m; colour #b9bcbe with darker bevel #6f7377

chrome_strip.description: thin polished-chrome moulding (about 0.02 m thick) running full width along the top edge of the white lower front, directly under the black windscreen base band. It is horizontal at Y 1.00 for |x| from 0.14 to 0.92 and forms a shallow downward gull-wing / 'V' pocket 0.34 m wide and 0.07 m deep in the centre which holds the lion emblem.

emblem.style: chrome stylised lion (MAN lion) set into the strip, darker recessed background

plate.style: Bulgarian EU plate: blue band + 'BG' on the left (bus right), black frame/holder with a dark text strip under the plate

fleet_number.font: heavy upright condensed grotesque (looks like a bold DIN-Engschrift / Arial Narrow Bold), black #0b0b0b, stroke about 0.02 m, digit width about 0.075 m, gap 0.012 m

pictograms_blue.note: only on the RIGHT half of the face, on the curved corner module (they follow the surface, so they look elliptical from the front). White thin rim. P2 shows only wheelchair + person because the pram disc is on the wrapped part.

livery.summary: Leaves HANG DOWN from the belt line (the sill, Y = 1.30) like a fringe / curtain of broad drooping leaves with pointed tips; they are NOT grass blades growing up from the skirt. The upper edge of each leaf is cut straight by the sill line. Tips point down; the lowest tips reach about Y 1.0-1.05, i.e. the leaves occupy only the top 0.2-0.33 m of the 0.97 m white panel. The rest of the lower panel (Y 0.33-1.0) is plain white except the logo and flaps.
livery.leaf_shape: pointed oval (teardrop) with a rounded broad end at the top and a sharp tip at the bottom; some leaves are fat with a rounded bottom
livery.leaf_orientation: hang vertically, tilt random +/-15 degrees; leaves at the cluster ends lean outwards
livery.density_and_overlap: about 5-6 leaves per metre of cluster, overlapping by 30-40 % in 2-3 layers (dark ones behind, light ones in front); a 2.2 m panel carries about 12 visible leaves
livery.outline: every leaf has a pale cream-white outline (about 0.012 m) and a lighter central vein on some, so overlapping leaves are separated by thin white lines

colours.sampling_note: photo samples under cool/evening light were #2a6a41 #336850 #4b8259 #4c8061 #629563 #82aa87 (P1/P3); the paint is a saturated leaf green family in 4 tones
